description: Shared vectors. `input` is parsed as JSON by each implementation; `expected` is the exact canonical text; `sha256` is over the UTF-8 bytes of `expected`. Object keys that differ only by letter case are forbidden by the contract because CFML struct keys are case-insensitive.

vectors.name: key ordering is UTF-16 code unit order, uppercase before lowercase
nested structures with null, booleans and arrays keep array order
string escaping and unicode passthrough
vectors.input: {"s":"quote \" backslash \\ slash / tab \t newline \n cr \r bs \b ff \f ctrl \u0001 \u001f middot \u00b7 dash \u2013 emoji \ud83d\ude00"}
vectors.expected: {"s":"quote \" backslash \\ slash / tab \t newline \n cr \r bs \b ff \f ctrl \u0001 \u001f middot · dash – emoji 😀"}

vectors.name: numbers: integers plain, decimals shortest, negative zero not distinguished, large integers without exponent
